qualifier: proliferation, migration, commitment and restraint of differentiation
name: Myoblast commitment, proliferation, migration and differentiation restraint
rationale: All members concern myoblast fate, proliferation, migration, fusion or differentiation; unlike the confusables it carries negative regulation of myoblast/myotube differentiation and proliferation plus migration, without satellite-cell or broad myogenesis sets.

qualifier: cohesion, alignment and metaphase-anaphase checkpoint control
name: Meiotic chromosome cohesion, alignment and segregation control
rationale: Members cover meiotic sister cohesion, chiasmata, metaphase alignment, poleward movement and checkpoint control of anaphase, distinguishing it from confusables about meiosis I entry, oocyte spindle positioning or recombination/synapsis.

qualifier: Rap1-driven activation and outside-in signalling to stress fibres and spreading
name: Integrin activation and outside-in signalling to stress fibres
rationale: All members concern integrin activation (Rap1, signal complex) and downstream adhesion signalling (ILK-PINCH-parvin, Cas/GRB2-SOS, Rho-PAK/ROCK) to stress fibres and spreading, unlike confusables centred on fibroblast migration, matrix assembly, platelets or shear stress.

qualifier: TLR, TNF and NF-kappaB signalling inhibition
name: TLR, TNF and NF-kappaB inflammatory signalling suppression
rationale: Every member is a negative regulation of TLR2/4/LPS, TNF or NF-kappaB signalling or of the inflammatory cytokines they induce; confusables lack the NF-kappaB and TNF-signalling inhibition and add positive regulation, IL-10/IL-12 or inflammasome sets.

qualifier: extends to Th1 and T-cell cytokines (IL-2, IL-21)
name: Restraint of innate cytokine, NF-kappaB and Th1 responses
rationale: Members mostly inhibit TLR/NF-kappaB/TNF signalling and inflammatory cytokine production, and uniquely add control of IL-2, IL-21, Th1 and Treg responses, separating it from the purely innate confusables and from the T-cell-only suppression set.

qualifier: ribosomal subunit and Rev RNA export
name: Nuclear pore complex function in ribosome and Rev export
rationale: Members describe the nuclear pore complex, its postmitotic reformation and cargo traffic (ribosomal subunits, HIV Rev) plus gene tethering at the pore, whereas confusables cover NPC assembly/disassembly, inositol phosphate transport or generic import regulation.

qualifier: sarcomere thick and thin filament assembly
name: Sarcomere filament assembly and striated muscle contraction
rationale: All members concern sarcomeric actin/myosin filament assembly, sliding and striated muscle contraction or stretch sensing, unlike confusables on cell junctions, myogenesis or muscle growth and adaptation.

qualifier: kainate/AMPA receptors and presynaptic Gbeta-gamma channel control
name: Kainate receptor signalling and presynaptic Gbeta-gamma channel modulation
rationale: Members combine kainate/AMPA receptor activation with presynaptic G-protein-gated K+ and Ca2+ channel modulation; confusables lack the kainate/AMPA receptors or the presynaptic G-protein modulation.

qualifier: tubulin glutamylation and microtubule severing
name: Centrosomal microtubule organisation with tubulin glutamylation and severing
rationale: Members cover microtubule nucleation, anchoring and centrosome positioning, and uniquely include tubulin C-terminal (poly)glutamylation and severing, whereas confusables add spindle orientation, cilia and centriole duplication.

qualifier: GG/TC-NER incision steps and error-free POLH bypass
name: UV-induced nucleotide excision repair and error-free POLH bypass
rationale: Members are GG- and TC-NER recognition/incision steps, UV responses and error-free POLH translesion synthesis, unlike confusables on error-prone TLS, gap filling, replication or base excision repair.

qualifier: desmosomes, hemidesmosomes and basement membrane adhesion
name: Cell-cell and cell-basement membrane anchoring junctions
rationale: Members cover desmosome/hemidesmosome assembly, cadherin adhesion and laminin/collagen/integrin basement-membrane contacts, unlike confusables centred on adherens junctions and apical polarity or cornified envelope.

qualifier: NRF2, HIF and p53 regulation of glycolysis
name: NRF2, HIF and p53 control of glycolytic metabolism
rationale: Members are NRF2 target programs, HIF hypoxia signalling, p53/mTORC1 metabolic genes and glycolysis, fructose-2,6-bisphosphate, lactate and NADP+ metabolism, distinguishing it from confusables on ROS/ferroptosis or FOXO signalling.

qualifier: with its inborn organic acidemias
name: Branched-chain amino acid catabolism and its organic acidemias
rationale: Members are leucine, valine and isoleucine catabolism, short-chain acyl-CoA handling and their enzyme-deficiency disorders, unlike confusables on carnitine/choline/threonine or biotin metabolism.

qualifier: RUNX1-driven erythroid, megakaryocytic and granulocytic
name: RUNX1-driven erythroid, megakaryocytic and granulocytic haematopoiesis
rationale: Members span RUNX-family transcription, stem/progenitor control and erythroid, megakaryocyte and granulocyte differentiation, whereas confusables emphasise M-CSF/macrophage or bone marrow development.

qualifier: retinol/retinal metabolism and its defects
name: Visual-cycle retinoid metabolism and its defects
rationale: Members are rod/cone retinoid cycles, retinol/retinal and vitamin A metabolism, A2E formation and retinoid-cycle gene defects, unlike confusables on retinoic acid metabolism or opsin phototransduction.

qualifier: with associated organic acidurias
name: Leucine catabolism and associated organic acidurias
rationale: Members are leucine catabolism and the inborn errors of its pathway (MCC deficiency, isovaleric acidemia, 3-methylglutaconic aciduria, beta-ketothiolase deficiency), lacking the valine/isoleucine, fatty acid and biotin sets of the confusables.

qualifier: factor VIII and IX (haemophilia)
name: Defective factor VIII and IX variants in haemophilia
rationale: All members are defective F8 or F9 variant events, distinguishing it from confusables on normal coagulation, VWF variants or contact-pathway defects.

qualifier: axoneme, manchette and mitochondrial sheath
name: Spermiogenic assembly of axoneme, manchette and mitochondrial sheath
rationale: Members build spermatid structures (axoneme, central apparatus, manchette, mitochondrial sheath) plus the Sertoli barrier, whereas confusables cover sperm motility, dynein arms and motile cilia, or tubulin modification.

core: Mitochondrial protein import and quality control
qualifier: dynamics and PINK1-Parkin mitophagy
name: Mitochondrial protein import, dynamics and PINK1-Parkin quality control
rationale: Members cover mitochondrial protein targeting/processing, cristae, calcium uptake, fission/fusion and PINK1-Parkin mitophagy, unlike confusables on general autophagosome machinery or ER-mitochondria tethering.

qualifier: via sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium handling and heart rate
name: Calcium-handling control of cardiac contractility and heart rate
rationale: Members regulate heart rate, contractile force and relaxation through SR calcium uptake/release and membrane calcium flux, unlike confusables on cardiac conduction, skeletal ryanodine/store-operated calcium or action potential suppression.

qualifier: nephric duct and ureteric bud formation
name: Nephric duct and ureteric bud formation
rationale: Members cover intermediate mesoderm, nephric/mesonephric duct and ureteric bud formation, elongation and branching, unlike confusables on nephron and metanephric mesenchyme development.

name: Hox gene clusters
rationale: All six members are Hox cluster gene sets, unlike confusables on somitogenesis, hindbrain patterning or RUNX1 transcription.

qualifier: NHEJ and PARP ADP-ribosylation
name: Double-strand break sensing, NHEJ and PARP ADP-ribosylation
rationale: Members cover DSB sensing/ATM signalling, classical and alternative NHEJ, repair-pathway choice and PARP-mediated ADP-ribosylation, unlike confusables on BRCA-dependent HR or replication-stress chromatin.

qualifier: germinal-centre route to plasma cells
name: Germinal-centre B cell activation toward plasma cells
rationale: Members cover B cell proliferation and differentiation, germinal-centre and Tfh/ICOS help and plasma-cell/immunoglobulin programmes, unlike confusables on B cell homeostasis, memory and surface signatures.

qualifier: MTF1-metallothionein heavy-metal responses
name: Zinc homeostasis and metallothionein heavy-metal responses
rationale: Members cover SLC39/SLC30 zinc transport, MTF1 and metallothioneins and responses to zinc, cadmium, copper and mercury, unlike confusables centred on copper, manganese or iron transport.
